description: Without a lock, an unnamed version is kb-core's pin (bmp581 0.1.0) or the newest release; the new image names every version.

files.kb-fetch.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# kb-fetch.sh: adds kb-core, the MCU port and the drivers of the image "pinned" to this git repository as
# submodules under external/, each checked out at its tag (a kb-core development revision: at its commit) and
# verified against the commit in kb-image.lock.yml (ADR-0012, ADR-0014). A tag that moved is refused. No branch
# is recorded in .gitmodules and nothing is fetched recursively. Rerunning it is safe. Written by kb resolve.
#
#   sh kb-fetch.sh            add or update every pin
#   sh kb-fetch.sh --verify   only check that every submodule is at its pinned commit
set -eu

mode=add
if [ "${1:-}" = "--verify" ]; then mode=verify; fi
top=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || { echo "kb-fetch: run this inside a git repository" >&2; exit 1; }
cd "$top"

die() {
  printf 'kb-fetch: error: %s\n' "$*" >&2
  exit 1
}

# pin <path> <url> <tag, empty for a commit pin> <commit>
pin() {
  path=$1 url=$2 tag=$3 want=$4
  if [ "$mode" = verify ]; then
    [ -e "$path/.git" ] || die "$path is missing; run without --verify"
  else
    if [ ! -e "$path/.git" ]; then
      git submodule add --quiet "$url" "$path" || die "cannot add $url"
    fi
    if [ -n "$tag" ]; then
      git -C "$path" fetch --quiet origin "+refs/tags/$tag:refs/tags/$tag" || die "cannot fetch $tag of $url"
      got=$(git -C "$path" rev-parse "refs/tags/$tag^{commit}")
      [ "$got" = "$want" ] || die "$path: tag $tag points at $got, expected $want (the tag moved; it is not used)"
    else
      git -C "$path" fetch --quiet origin "$want" || die "cannot fetch commit $want of $url"
    fi
    git -C "$path" -c advice.detachedHead=false checkout --quiet "$want"
    git config -f .gitmodules --unset "submodule.$path.branch" 2>/dev/null || true
    git add .gitmodules "$path"
  fi
  head=$(git -C "$path" rev-parse HEAD)
  [ "$head" = "$want" ] || die "$path is at $head, expected $want"
  printf 'kb-fetch: %s at %s (%s)\n' "$path" "${tag:-commit}" "$want"
}

# kb-core 0.4.1
pin 'external/kb-core' 'https://github.com/kokeb-labs/kb-core.git' 'v0.4.1' '83518d7664b87cabd87681c5835cc32c4c78ab49'
# driver bmp581 0.2.1
pin 'external/drivers/driver-bmp581' 'https://github.com/kokeb-labs-drivers/driver-bmp581.git' 'v0.2.1' '1671f9f12669fe928c539076554fdd132063902b'
# driver tmc5160 0.1.0
pin 'external/drivers/driver-tmc5160' 'https://github.com/kokeb-labs-drivers/driver-tmc5160.git' 'v0.1.0' '87805bc54d9e54be18e00ac217f56679adb2b5da'

if [ "$mode" = add ]; then
  echo "kb-fetch: done; review with git status and commit the submodules"
fi
files.kb-upgrade.md:
# Upgrade report: pinned

kb-core 0.4.0 to 0.4.1, MCU esp32/esp32, RTOS freertos. Release candidates not picked unless named.

2 of 3 component(s) change.

| Component | From | To | Change | Breaking | Newest release | Newer rc | Known vulnerabilities |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| kb-core | 0.4.0 | 0.4.1 | patch | no | 0.4.1 | 0.5.0-rc.1 | not scanned -> none |
| bmp581 | 0.1.0 | 0.2.1 | minor | yes | 1.0.0 | - | CVE-2026-0001 -> none |
| tmc5160 | 0.1.0 | 0.1.0 | none | no | 0.1.0 | - | not scanned |

## Breaking changes

- bmp581 0.1.0 -> 0.2.1: read its release notes and CHANGELOG before building: https://github.com/kokeb-labs-drivers/driver-bmp581/releases/tag/v0.2.1

## Held back

- bmp581 1.0.0: needs a newer kb-core (KB-RES-014)

## Known vulnerabilities

- fixed by this upgrade: CVE-2026-0001 (bmp581)
- not scanned: tmc5160

## Warnings

- KB-UPG-W01 bmp581: breaking change
- KB-UPG-W02 bmp581: newer version held back

## Next steps

1. Review the changes to `kb-image.yml` and `kb-image.lock.yml` with `git diff`.
2. Run `sh kb-fetch.sh` to move every submodule to its new tag, then build and run your tests.
3. Check the compatibility of the new set: a tested version set, or an untested combination.

# kb image pinned: written by kb resolve from kb-image.yml (schema 1); do not edit.
# kb-core 0.4.1 at 83518d7664b87cabd87681c5835cc32c4c78ab49, MCU esp32/esp32, RTOS freertos.
set(KB_MCU "ESP32")
set(KB_RTOS "FREERTOS")

set(KB_ENABLE_BMP581 ON)
set(KB_ENABLE_TMC5160 ON)
set(KB_DRIVER_BMP581_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/external/drivers/driver-bmp581")
set(KB_DRIVER_TMC5160_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/external/drivers/driver-tmc5160")
